results: Requirement N30 verified: a real git transport clone of the staged source, npm run setup and the supervised loopback runtime complete the project's full reference workflow, negative cases, restart and restore.

Clean-clone install proof: the clone tree equals the exact staged tree, npm ci installs the locked dependencies with lifecycle scripts disabled, the web workspace builds, and dist/engine/policyhelix compiles inside the clone; no prebuilt artifacts are reused.

Real readiness proof: the supervised engine reports storage durable and all three required providers connected (local_opa embedded self-test, self_hosted_keycloak synthetic local demo store round-trip, owned_synthetic_upstream HTTP probe) before the workflow is allowed to run.

Six-stage workflow executed over the supervised HTTP surface: simulator fixture C01-POS-01 expected allow matched; Ed25519 signed bundle accepted with signature verified, durable activation and monotonic revision; authenticated request forwarded through the allowlisted gateway to the owned upstream with HTTP 200; forged headers stripped and direct origin rejected with HTTP 403; revocation stopped the next request with REVOKED_SESSION and zero side effects; decision-engine and IdP outages denied while an expired bundle was rejected and the active authority retained.

All seven required negative fixtures executed: spoofed header, direct origin, revoked session, expired bundle, unavailable provider, malformed fixture and unavailable runtime each produced the declared typed error or fail-closed outcome instead of placeholder success.

Restart and restore: the supervisor stopped and restarted against the same durable storage directory; state restored with active bundle revision 1, highest revision 1 and one revoked session; the revoked session remained denied and the still-valid session still reached the owned upstream with HTTP 200.

Browser acceptance: the Reference Workflow page runs all six stages against the live engine, shows real stage results, and a fresh page load reads the durable bundle back from local storage; the full Playwright suite passes 36 tests with no page errors.
C01 fixtures remain frozen and intact; the scenario contract declares observed_from for every stage and the validator has 12 negative regression cases, including missing execution observations.
No database schema, migration, .env or Dockerfile was modified; no paid/cloud account, public domain, sibling clone or telemetry is required.
observed_limitations: The clean-host proof is a real git transport clone executed on the supported Linux development host with the documented Go 1.26.2 and Node 24.19.0 toolchains installed; it did not provision a separate pristine OS image and does not measure the 2 vCPU / 4096 MiB minimum target.

The local-demo identity provider issues engine-local fingerprint-bound revocable sessions through durable storage instead of running Keycloak; readiness labels this verification synthetic_local_demo. The local-private profile still requires real identity/provider durability evidence before sensitive use.
coreReady and businessFeaturesCompleted remain false; C40 still requires authorized published source/artifacts and an installed full-workflow proof.

This development host exports a local HTTP proxy, so verification commands ran with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY unset to keep loopback probes direct. No source or CI configuration depends on that local setting.
